description: This file is a shell script used to test the configuration and behavior of the 'git pack-objects' command with various compression settings. It sets up test objects, runs tests with different compression options, and checks the resulting pack file sizes to ensure correct functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, used to run specific test commands and validate output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after tests complete.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing sequence.

methods.name: test_file_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a specified file.
